description: Users sign up, verify their email, and either become active or churn after a week.
raw:
{
  "name": "User onboarding and churn",
  "summary": "Users sign up, verify their email, and within a week either engage to become active users or churn.",
  "places": [
    {"id": "pending_verification", "label": "Pending verification", "description": "Users who registered and need to verify their email address.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
    {"id": "in_trial", "label": "In first week", "description": "Verified users exploring the product during their first week.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
    {"id": "unverified_abandoned", "label": "Unverified abandoned", "description": "Users who never completed email verification.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
    {"id": "active_users", "label": "Active users", "description": "Users who engaged and became regular active users.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
    {"id": "churned_users", "label": "Churned users", "description": "Users who did not engage and churned after their first week.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0}
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {"id": "sign_up", "label": "Sign up", "description": "A new visitor creates an account.", "rate": 50.0},
    {"id": "verify_email", "label": "Verify email", "description": "A user clicks the confirmation link.", "rate": 40.0},
    {"id": "abandon_verification", "label": "Abandon sign-up", "description": "A user fails to verify their email within a reasonable time.", "rate": 10.0},
    {"id": "activate", "label": "Become active", "description": "A verified user engages sufficiently to become retained.", "rate": 15.0},
    {"id": "churn", "label": "Churn after week", "description": "A verified user stops using the platform after the first week.", "rate": 25.0}
  ],
  "arcs": [
    {"from": "sign_up", "to": "pending_verification", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
    {"from": "pending_verification", "to": "verify_email", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
    {"from": "verify_email", "to": "in_trial", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
    {"from": "pending_verification", "to": "abandon_verification", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
    {"from": "abandon_verification", "to": "unverified_abandoned", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
    {"from": "in_trial", "to": "activate", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
    {"from": "activate", "to": "active_users", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
    {"from": "in_trial", "to": "churn", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
    {"from": "churn", "to": "churned_users", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false}
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Rates are modeled per day.",
    "About 50 users register per day.",
    "80% of registered users verify their email promptly; 20% abandon before verification.",
    "Of verified users, around 37.5% become active while 62.5% churn over the first week."
  ]
}
